items.title: The cost of leaving an honest answer unrevisited
items.description: Illustrative teaching model, not a real measurement: once a real decision is pending, each unrevisited day after the honest Day 3 answer adds visible risk points, up to a maximum of 100. Drag the number of days between the ask and Sam's decision deadline to see why a truthful answer should be revisited when stakes change. At 9 days (Day 3 to Day 12) and 7 teaching points per day, the model shows 63 — high enough to notice before Day 14's announcement.
